steps.name: publish
argv:
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
srcdir = "C:/banyan-farm/goblin-ipa-0812/out-b07-scavcostume-0819"
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b07-scavcostume-0819"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
src = sorted(glob.glob(srcdir + "/07-confiscate-*"))
pngs = [f for f in src if f.lower().endswith(".png")]
lines = []
for f in src:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-b07-scavcostume-0819.sha256"), "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print("published", len(src), "file(s),", len(pngs), "png + manifest ->", dst)
# frame count is 12, not 16: 4 seeds x 3 DISTINCT reference sha256s. refs-guards-twoinfield-nos2-0815 holds 3 distinct images in 4 slots (s0 and s3 are the same bytes; hashed on the box 2026-08-17), and dedup_cells drops the cell that would redraw s0, so the grid is 3 cells x 4 seeds. Hardcoded rather than derived from seeds x distinct-ref-sha256 because deriving it means mirroring the sampler slot enumeration while another lane is editing the sampler; derive it when that settles.
raise SystemExit(0 if len(pngs) >= 12 else 1)

steps.name: verify
argv:
import glob, sys
d = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b07-scavcostume-0819"
p = sorted(glob.glob(d + "/07-confiscate-*.png"))
print("published pngs:", len(p))
for f in p:
    print("   ", f.rsplit("/", 1)[-1])
if len(p) < 12:
    sys.exit("FAILED: %d published png(s), expected 12 (3 distinct reference cells x 4 seeds). A short grid is not a sample, and the manifest alone cannot tell the difference." % len(p))
